name: Glass stock left
oneLiner: a product card on glass with a real cut-out under a spotlight and a Selling fast chip: the units-left number ticks down faster and faster as a segmented stock bar drains from amber to red, then an inked Sold out stamp slams over the product, the product goes dark and the button dies
say: when the speaker says something sold out or went fast ('it sold out in a day', 'there were only a few left'): cut in as they set it up, the count runs down under the line and the stamp lands on 'sold out'; set units to the number they say and img to their own product
